_readme: QualiLens model catalog. Edit THIS file when a provider retires or
releases a model — no code changes needed. The first model that
matches default_model is preselected in the wizard; users can always
type a custom model id there as well. Verify your edits with the
'Check models' button in Settings, which compares this catalog against
the provider's live model list using your API key (free, no tokens).
Edits take effect on the next page load — no restart needed. Caveat:
some vendors serve alias ids (e.g. '-latest') that work in chat but may
not appear in their list endpoint; a working model marked ✗ may simply
be an alias — confirm with the Test button before removing it.
pricing_usd_per_mtok feeds only the pre-run cost estimate. It is either
[input, output] per million tokens for the whole provider, or an object
{"default": [in, out], "<model id>": [in, out], ...} so the estimate
can price the model the project chose; a model with no entry uses the
default. Prices are the authors' reading of public list prices at the
time of editing and are not guaranteed — check the provider's page.
Google: the 3.6 and 3.8 Flash prices are introductory until
2026-12-31 ($1.50 / $7.50 from 2027-01-01) — update the default then.
gemini-4-argon carries its price from 2026-12-01 ($4.00 / $20.00; Google
charges half until 2026-11-30) and is not on Google's free tier.
The 2.5 prices are kept, unlisted, for projects that still use them;
from 2026-12-01 Google answers gemini-2.5-pro with 3.8-flash and
gemini-2.5-flash with 3.5-flash-lite, bills those rates, and the report
names the model that answered. 3.7-flash is deprecated (Google answers
it with 3.8-flash); it is unlisted, and projects that used it are priced
by the default.
OpenAI: gpt-5 (shutdown 2026-12-11), gpt-5.1 (shutdown 2027-04-01),
gpt-4.1 and gpt-4o (both shut down 2027-01-14) are deprecated and
unlisted; their prices are kept for projects that still use them.
gpt-6-luna is the inexpensive model OpenAI names as their replacement.
Anthropic: prices are per model. The Haiku 5.5 price is Anthropic's rate
for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, which QualiLens's calls stay under.
claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 are still
served but unlisted since the 5.5 generation; their prices are kept.
Mistral: Large 3 and Medium 3.5 were deprecated on 2026-10-31 (retired
2027-04-30; Large 4 replaces both) and the -latest aliases still named
them on 2026-11-04, so the catalog lists mistral-large-4 (Mistral's price
of 2026-11-04) and mistral-small-latest (Small 4, priced from Mistral's
page). mistral-large-latest and mistral-medium-latest are unlisted; their
prices are kept for projects that still use them (Medium's from
third-party listings of 2026-10-24). Mistral's -latest aliases move to
new versions silently; the app records the alias.
Check models asks Google about each listed model for free, because
Google keeps listing models it refuses to some projects (the 2.5
models, for projects new to them). paid_only names models a free key
has zero quota for, which no free check can see; the wizard marks them.
If this file is missing or invalid, the app falls back to defaults
compiled into backend/app/llm.py. An in-app update replaces this file;
an edited copy is saved as <data folder>/models.json.previous so your
edits can be reapplied.
